title: Alice Zeno's name, birth in 1864 and the end of the war
summary: Alice gives her maiden and married names, her age (94) and her birth on St. Claude Street in June 1864, a few months after the war ended.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: You don't understand? No, I never did learn French. If you could tell us your name first
or we'll have it on the tape. Right now? Yes. You want my name now? Yes. Well, in English, eh? Yes. Well, my name is Alice, my maiden name you want? Yeah, that'd be good too. Your maiden
name and then your... Alice William Zeno. And your married name was Zeno. Yes,

you know, Louis Zeno. Henry Louis Zeno was my married name. And my maiden name was Alice William. Can you tell us how old you are now? Well, now I'll be 94 years old in four months, five months from now. 95? Eh? 95 and five. 94. I'm 94 now. 94 now. Yeah. Where were you born? Right on in the city or outside? I was born on St. Claude Street between Calarack and Columbus. Right here in this city. Well, this is not the city. Yes. Over there. I still think I'm over there too.
St. Claude Street, you know? Your birthday? The 7th of June. I remembered that. I wanted to get it on here.
Yeah. The 7th of June, what year was that? In 1864. 1864. See? When? In 1864. I see.
I see. Maybe not a fire. Was the war around then? You wouldn't remember, I mean, do you remember when the war was over?

The war was over. About April, wasn't it? Yes. The war was over, you know, everything was all right, settled for the month of April. And I was born in the month of June. Yeah, that's what I thought. It was just about three months, four months, three months after everything was settled.
